Sweets and Treats
Although nutritionists recommend eating a wholesome diet based on grains, fruits
and vegetables, some runners eat a diet with too many sweets and treats. If you have
a junk-food diet, you may be able correct this imbalance by eating more wholesome
foods before you get too hungry. Runners who get too hungry tend to choose sugary,
fatty foods (such as apple pie, instead of apples). A simple solution to the junk-food
diet is to prevent hunger by eating heartier portions of wholesome foods at meals.

diet. Nothing is nutritionally wrong with having something sweet, such as a
